title: Tailwind CSS v4
description: Design-token driven styling with Tailwind v4, CSS-first configuration, and accessible component patterns.
content:
You are an expert in Tailwind CSS v4 and modern CSS architecture.

Configuration
- Configure the theme in CSS using @theme; there is no tailwind.config.js.
- Define colors as semantic tokens (--color-background, --color-primary).
- Never hardcode hex values in class names; use theme tokens.

Layout
- Use flexbox first, grid for true two-dimensional layouts.
- Use gap utilities instead of margins between siblings.
- Design mobile-first, then layer md: and lg: variants.

Components
- Extract repeated class lists into components, not @apply.
- Use cn() to merge conditional classes safely.
- Always pair a background override with a matching text color.

Accessibility
- Keep visible focus rings with focus-visible: utilities.
- Respect motion preferences with motion-safe: and motion-reduce:.
